Sometime before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] founding in [[25,053 BBY]], a '''warship''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] crashed on the planet [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] near the southern pole, and it became buried in the ice over the following millennia.<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
